- Mega Holdings Sdn. Bhd. holds 60.0% of shares  

**Overview:**  
Sejahtera Kirana Engineering Sdn. Bhd. is a private limited construction firm that performs public road and drainage engineering works in Terengganu. The company was incorporated on 30 April 2001 and is currently active, with two directors and one corporate shareholder. Ownership is concentrated, with Mega Holdings Sdn. Bhd. holding a 60.0 % stake.  

**Financial snapshot (2022‑2024):**  
Revenue rose from RM 7,433,314 to RM 8,195,177; profit after tax increased from RM 123,316 to RM 217,029. Current ratios improved from 1.3 to 1.52, and interest coverage rose from 1.6986 to 2.1151. All three years received an unqualified audit opinion. No legal cases are recorded.
